text: Foundation models unlocked unstructured data. The bigger prize is streaming data: how much to order, which payment to stop, when the pump will fail.
Now I B M Granite Time Series models are live on Confluent. Trained once, they work on series they have never seen.
They tell you what comes next, how far it sits from normal, which history looks like this one, and which settings hit the target.
Confluent streams and governs the data with zero configuration, so every model sees live business signals.
That changes the economics. No bespoke model per series, no months of expert work, no safety margins paid every cycle.
No army of data scientists: a demand planner, a fraud analyst or a process engineer puts them to work on their own streams.
On a factory line, it forecasts the shift, flags a slow drift and finds the last run like this one.
Forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization and search on every stream. Contact us to start with yours.
